knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Lone working is avoided where possible, and a buddy or supervision is arranged where it is not.
The crew stops, moves away and keeps a clear exit, and does not confront the person.
A trespasser is not challenged, and the event is reported. An unfamiliar area is not entered alone.

practicalCriteria: Sets a check-in schedule with named contacts before a simulated lone task
Responds to a simulated threatening visitor by stopping, moving away and keeping an exit clear
Does not challenge a simulated trespasser and reports the event
Completes an incident report with times, people, actions and notifications
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A lone task starts without a check-in arranged
The learner confronts or retaliates against a visitor
The learner enters a locked area alone to investigate
